method Derivative(xs: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
    requires |xs| > 0 // The input list must not be empty.
    ensures |result| == |xs| - 1 // The result will have one less coefficient than the input.
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] == xs[i + 1] * (i + 1) // Each coefficient is multiplied by its degree.
{
    var n := |xs|; // Length of the input sequence
    var res := new int[n - 1]; // Initialize the result array with size n - 1
    var i := 0; // Index for the result array
    while i < n - 1
        invariant 0 <= i <= n - 1 // i is within bounds
        invariant forall j :: 0 <= j < i ==> res[j] == xs[j + 1] * (j + 1) // The result array is correctly filled up to index i
    {
        res[i] := xs[i + 1] * (i + 1); // Calculate the derivative coefficient
        i := i + 1; // Move to the next index
    }
    result := res; // Return the result
}
```
